raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

Fixes #44106.

`--enable-symm-mem` preallocates a 4 GiB symmetric-memory pool in
`finalize_cuda_graph_capture`, **after** the KV pool is sized. That
allocation is not charged against `--mem-fraction-static`, so a config
that fits without the flag can OOM during warmup or the first NCCL
verify broadcast once the flag is on. MLA models also skip
post-capture KV resize, so the leftover slack never grows to cover the
pool.

This is the same class of bug as the existing multimodal reservation:
memory that is allocated only after KV sizing has to come out of the KV
budget, not the runtime slack.

## Modifications

- Add `symm_mem_runtime_reservation_gb()` next to `mm_runtime_reservation_gb()`.
- Subtract that reservation in `KVCacheConfigurator._profile_available_bytes`.
- Keep the default 4 GiB prealloc, and note in the warning that it is
  taken out of the KV budget.
- CPU regression tests: helper cases plus an explicit
  `--mem-fraction-static=0.90` profile that still loses 4 GiB.

NCCL CUMEM/NVLS buffers still come from leftover slack. The reporter's
0.90 vs 0.88 working delta on B200 is ~4 GiB, which matches the
prealloc pool. Shrinking `SGLANG_SYMM_MEM_PREALLOC_GB_SIZE` is not used
as a workaround (see #36943).

## Accuracy Tests

Not applicable — memory accounting only; no model-forward or sampling
change.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Not applicable. KV capacity drops by the prealloc size when the flag is
on (4 GiB by default), which is the intended trade for not OOM'ing after
start-up.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the Format code with pre-commit.
- [x] Add unit tests according to the Run and add unit tests.
- [ ] Update documentation according to Write documentations. (No
      user-facing flag change; the existing warning now states the KV
      budget effect.)
- [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to Test
      the accuracy and Benchmark the speed. (N/A, see above.)
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style guidance.

## Review and Merge Process

1. Ping Merge Oncalls to start the process.
2. Get approvals from CODEOWNERS and other reviewers.
3. Trigger CI tests with comments or contact authorized users to do so.
   - Common commands include `/tag-and-rerun-ci`, `/tag-run-ci-label`, `/rerun-failed-ci`

@@ -351,8 +351,11 @@ def handle_gpu_memory_settings(server_args: Any):
     if cfg.enable_symm_mem and not envs.SGLANG_SYMM_MEM_PREALLOC_GB_SIZE.is_set():
         envs.SGLANG_SYMM_MEM_PREALLOC_GB_SIZE.set(4)
         logger.warning(
-            "Symmetric memory is enabled, setting symmetric memory prealloc size to 4GB as default."
-            "Use environment variable SGLANG_SYMM_MEM_PREALLOC_GB_SIZE to change the prealloc size."
+            "Symmetric memory is enabled, setting symmetric memory prealloc size "
+            "to 4GB as default. Use environment variable "
+            "SGLANG_SYMM_MEM_PREALLOC_GB_SIZE to change the prealloc size. "
+            "This reservation is taken out of the KV cache budget so it does "
+            "not have to fit in --mem-fraction-static leftover slack."
         )

@@ -214,6 +214,27 @@ def mm_runtime_reservation_gb(
     return reserved_mb / 1024
 
 
+def symm_mem_runtime_reservation_gb(*, enable_symm_mem: bool) -> float:
+    """Symmetric-memory pool allocated after the KV pool is sized.
+
+    ``prealloc_symmetric_memory_pool`` runs in ``finalize_cuda_graph_capture``,
+    after the KV budget is already committed. Leave that prealloc out of the
+    KV budget so it does not have to fit in ``--mem-fraction-static`` leftover
+    slack. See issue #44106.
+    """
+    if not enable_symm_mem:
+        return 0.0
+    prealloc_gb = envs.SGLANG_SYMM_MEM_PREALLOC_GB_SIZE.get()
+    if prealloc_gb <= 0:
+        return 0.0
+    logger.info(
+        "Reserving %.2f GB of the KV budget for the post-sizing symmetric-"
+        "memory prealloc (SGLANG_SYMM_MEM_PREALLOC_GB_SIZE).",
+        float(prealloc_gb),
+    )
+    return float(prealloc_gb)
+
+
 # base ratio of mamba pool size to max_running_requests. Under
 # SGLANG_OPT_MAMBA_SKIP_DECODE_LOCK the decode-time skip frees one resident slot
 # per running request, so the base drops by 1 (overlap 5->4, lazy 4->3). no_buffer
@@ -2713,7 +2734,12 @@ def _profile_available_bytes(self, pre_model_load_memory: int) -> int:
             is_multimodal=self.model_config.is_multimodal,
             mm_feature_transport=get_mm().mm_feature_transport,
         )
-        rest_memory = available_gpu_memory - slack_gb - mm_reservation_gb
+        symm_reservation_gb = symm_mem_runtime_reservation_gb(
+            enable_symm_mem=get_exec().comm.enable_symm_mem,
+        )
+        rest_memory = (
+            available_gpu_memory - slack_gb - mm_reservation_gb - symm_reservation_gb
+        )
         if self.mambaish_config is not None:
             rest_memory = self._handle_max_mamba_cache(rest_memory)

+# ==============================================================================
+"""CPU regressions for taking the symmetric-memory prealloc out of the KV budget.
+
+``prealloc_symmetric_memory_pool`` runs after the KV pool is sized, so the
+prealloc must not be left to fit in ``--mem-fraction-static`` leftover slack.
+See issue #44106.
+
+ python -m pytest test/registered/unit/mem_cache/test_symm_mem_kv_budget.py -v
+"""
+
+import unittest
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+from unittest.mock import patch
+
+from sglang.srt.mem_cache import kv_cache_configurator as kcc
+from sglang.srt.model_executor.cuda_graph_config import Backend
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cpu_ci
+from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase
+
+register_cpu_ci(est_time=4, suite="base-a-test-cpu")
+
+
+class TestSymmMemRuntimeReservation(CustomTestCase):
+    def test_disabled_is_zero(self):
+        self.assertEqual(
+            kcc.symm_mem_runtime_reservation_gb(enable_symm_mem=False), 0.0
+        )
+
+    def test_nonpositive_prealloc_is_zero(self):
+        for prealloc_gb in (-1, 0):
+            with patch.object(
+                kcc.envs.SGLANG_SYMM_MEM_PREALLOC_GB_SIZE,
+                "get",
+                return_value=prealloc_gb,
+            ):
+                self.assertEqual(
+                    kcc.symm_mem_runtime_reservation_gb(enable_symm_mem=True),
+                    0.0,
+                    prealloc_gb,
+                )
+
+    def test_default_four_gib_is_reserved(self):
+        with patch.object(
+            kcc.envs.SGLANG_SYMM_MEM_PREALLOC_GB_SIZE, "get", return_value=4
+        ):
+            self.assertEqual(
+                kcc.symm_mem_runtime_reservation_gb(enable_symm_mem=True), 4.0
+            )
+
+    def test_custom_prealloc_is_reserved(self):
+        with patch.object(
+            kcc.envs.SGLANG_SYMM_MEM_PREALLOC_GB_SIZE, "get", return_value=1
+        ):
+            self.assertEqual(
+                kcc.symm_mem_runtime_reservation_gb(enable_symm_mem=True), 1.0
+            )
+
+
+class TestSymmMemKvBudget(CustomTestCase):
+    """The 4 GiB default pool is subtracted even when mem_fraction_static is set."""
+
+    def _profile(self, *, enable_symm_mem: bool, prealloc_gb: int) -> int:
+        cfg = kcc.KVCacheConfigurator.__new__(kcc.KVCacheConfigurator)
+        cfg.device = "cuda"
+        cfg.gpu_id = 0
+        cfg.mambaish_config = None
+        cfg.post_capture_kv_active = False
+        cfg.model_config = SimpleNamespace(is_multimodal=False)
+
+        schedule = SimpleNamespace(
+            mem_fraction_static=0.90,
+            prefill_max_requests=None,
+            max_mamba_cache_size=None,
+        )
+        exec_ctx = SimpleNamespace(
+            comm=SimpleNamespace(enable_symm_mem=enable_symm_mem),
+            graph=SimpleNamespace(
+                cuda_graph_config=SimpleNamespace(
+                    prefill=SimpleNamespace(
+                        full_prefill_max_req=None,
+                        backend=Backend.DISABLED,
+                    )
+                )
+            ),
+        )
+        parallel = SimpleNamespace(
+            launch_world_size=1,
+            world_group=SimpleNamespace(cpu_group=None),
+        )
+        disagg = SimpleNamespace(disaggregation_mode="null")
+        mm = SimpleNamespace(mm_feature_transport=None)
+
+        with (
+            patch.object(kcc, "get_available_gpu_memory", return_value=40.0),
+            patch.object(kcc, "get_schedule", return_value=schedule),
+            patch.object(kcc, "get_exec", return_value=exec_ctx),
+            patch.object(kcc, "get_parallel", return_value=parallel),
+            patch.object(kcc, "get_disagg", return_value=disagg),
+            patch.object(kcc, "get_mm", return_value=mm),
+            patch.object(
+                kcc.envs.SGLANG_SYMM_MEM_PREALLOC_GB_SIZE,
+                "get",
+                return_value=prealloc_gb,
+            ),
+        ):
+            # pre_model_load_memory=100, mem_fraction=0.90 → slack=10 GB
+            # available=40 GB → 30 GB without the prealloc.
+            return cfg._profile_available_bytes(pre_model_load_memory=100)
+
+    def test_explicit_mem_fraction_still_loses_the_prealloc(self):
+        without = self._profile(enable_symm_mem=False, prealloc_gb=4)
+        with_pool = self._profile(enable_symm_mem=True, prealloc_gb=4)
+        self.assertEqual(without - with_pool, 4 << 30)
+
+    def test_disabled_prealloc_does_not_shrink_the_budget(self):
+        without = self._profile(enable_symm_mem=False, prealloc_gb=4)
+        disabled = self._profile(enable_symm_mem=True, prealloc_gb=0)
+        self.assertEqual(without, disabled)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()
